metadata.title: SPARC Azure Blob Storage Component Definition

components.title: Azure Storage Account and Blob Storage
components.description: Storage Account with TLS 1.2 minimum, private access by default, blob versioning, soft delete retention, and a private blob container. Deployed via Terraform (Azure/VM/modules/blob_storage/). <!-- UPDATE: Insert storage account name, container name, and resource group for your deployment. -->

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control implementations for Azure Blob Storage

implemented-requirements.description: Protection of Information at Rest: The Storage Account encrypts all data at rest using Azure Storage Service Encryption with AES-256 platform-managed keys. TLS 1.2 is enforced as the minimum version (min_tls_version = TLS1_2) for all API operations, ensuring encrypted transport for data access. All blob data, metadata, and service data are automatically encrypted. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000231, CIS Azure 3.1.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Terraform resource: azurerm_storage_account.main with min_tls_version = TLS1_2. Azure encrypts all storage account data at rest by default.

implemented-requirements.description: Access Enforcement: The Storage Account denies public access by default (allow_nested_items_to_be_public = false). Network rules enforce a default deny policy (network_rules default_action = Deny), requiring explicit network access grants. The blob container uses private access type (container_access_type = private), preventing anonymous blob access. The VM accesses storage via its managed identity with the Storage Blob Data Contributor RBAC role assignment (defined in the rbac module). Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000033, CIS Azure 3.7.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Terraform resources: azurerm_storage_account.main with allow_nested_items_to_be_public = false, network_rules default_action = Deny. azurerm_storage_container.main with container_access_type = private. RBAC: azurerm_role_assignment.storage_blob in rbac module.

implemented-requirements.description: System Backup: Blob versioning is enabled (versioning_enabled = true), automatically preserving previous versions of blobs on every overwrite or delete operation. Soft delete retention is configured for 7 days (delete_retention_policy days = 7), allowing recovery of accidentally deleted blobs within the retention window. The storage account replication type is configurable (e.g., LRS, GRS) for geographic redundancy. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000065.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Terraform resource: azurerm_storage_account.main blob_properties with versioning_enabled = true, delete_retention_policy days = 7. Replication type configured via var.replication_type.
